skill.summary: Build multi-component Claude artifacts with React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui, then bundle them as single HTML files.
skill.author: ComposioHQ

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate local artifact builder, but it relies on shell scripts that install packages, modify project files, and extract a bundled archive. Most documentation and schema URL findings are false positives, while command execution, filesystem modification, package installation, and the embedded archive require user awareness before installation.

remediation.issue: Setup and bundling scripts install packages from external registries.
remediation.suggestion: Pin dependency versions where possible and document that running the skill performs network package installation.

remediation.issue: The setup script extracts a bundled tar.gz archive into generated projects.
remediation.suggestion: Publish the archive contents as regular source files or add an integrity manifest for easier review.

remediation.issue: The bundling script deletes dist and bundle.html in the current directory.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before cleanup or scope generated output to a dedicated build directory.

semantic_findings.description: The scripts run pnpm and npm installation commands during setup and bundling. This creates supply-chain exposure because install scripts and package contents come from external registries.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The install commands are explicit and reachable in normal use. The risk is supply-chain exposure, not evidence of malicious intent.

semantic_findings.title: Local Archive Extraction into Generated Project
semantic_findings.description: The setup script extracts shadcn-components.tar.gz into the generated src directory. This is expected functionality, but archive extraction can overwrite files if archive contents are unsafe.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The extraction command is present and the archive is part of the skill. The observed archive listing looked scoped to components, so severity is low.

semantic_findings.title: Project Directory Cleanup Removes Local Paths

content.user_title: Build Rich Claude Artifacts with React
content.value_statement: Complex Claude artifacts often need state, routing, styling, and reusable components. This skill creates a ready React workspace and bundles the finished app into one HTML artifact.
actual_capabilities: Creates a React 18 and TypeScript project using Vite.
Configures Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui theme variables.
Installs Radix UI and related shadcn/ui component dependencies.
Adds path aliases for imports that use the @ prefix.
Bundles a built React app into a single HTML file.
Includes guidance for optional local preview and testing.
limitations: It is not intended for simple single-file HTML artifacts.
It requires Node.js 18 or newer and pnpm access.
It runs local shell scripts that install packages and edit files.
The bundled output depends on the generated project building successfully.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple artifact project

prompt_templates.scenario: Build a more polished interface using included components.

prompt_templates.title: Bundle a finished artifact
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a completed React artifact for sharing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Bundle the current React artifact into a single HTML file with artifacts-builder. Confirm the expected output file and note any build issues.

prompt_templates.title: Build and validate an advanced prototype
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with stateful UI and manual verification.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-step onboarding prototype with local state, responsive layout, and shadcn/ui controls. Bundle it, then test the main flow in a browser if tools are available.

output_examples.input: Create a React artifact for a pricing comparison page.
output_examples.output: A generated React project with Tailwind styling, reusable pricing cards, and instructions to run and bundle the artifact.

output_examples.input: Bundle my completed artifact for Claude.
output_examples.output: A single bundle.html file that contains the built app and can be shared as a Claude artifact.
A structured frontend project using shadcn/ui components such as cards, tabs, dialogs, tables, and form controls.

best_practices: Use this skill when the artifact needs React state, multiple components, or shadcn/ui controls.
Review generated dependencies before running install commands in sensitive environments.
Bundle only after the project builds and the main user flow has been checked.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for a small static HTML or JSX snippet.
Do not run the scripts in a directory with important dist or bundle.html files.
Do not assume the bundled artifact is accessible without testing keyboard and viewport behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a React and TypeScript artifact project with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui setup, and bundling support.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it for complex artifacts that need state, routing-like structure, or a component library.

faq.question: When should I avoid it?
faq.answer: Avoid it for simple artifacts that can be written as one small HTML or JSX file.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts use pnpm and npm commands, so review them before running in restricted environments.

faq.question: What is the final output?
faq.answer: The bundling script produces bundle.html, a self-contained HTML file for sharing as an artifact.
